normative_text: Journal records are checksummed, sealed, recoverable, and authoritative for execution state.
Commands are bounded, capability-authorized, versioned, and idempotent.
Release certification procedure defines RC hashing, seven-day soak, disaster drills, broker reconciliation, canary approvals, and immutable evidence manifest.
Native Rust terminal builds without a browser, WebView, Node, npm, or Tauri dependency.
Terminal configuration reload streams a bounded file and uses the engine compare-and-swap command.
Market stream gaps stop downstream state until explicit snapshot recovery.
Risk rejects stale or unhealthy inputs before execution and fails closed.
LLM output is provider-neutral, bounded, trace-bound, and schema-validated before action.
Graph facts retain temporal provenance and retrieval enforces embedding model compatibility.
Autonomous approval is policy-bound and revalidated against unchanged critical context.
Manual order submission requires preview, warnings, explicit confirmation, and idempotency.
Operational terminal refresh cadence is bounded and does not overlap in-flight diagnostic requests.
Alert routing is bounded, HTTPS-only, credential-safe, and acknowledges in-app and external channels independently.
Provider and article URLs are bounded, authority-present, HTTPS/localhost constrained, and contain no credentials.
Yahoo multi-symbol subscriptions are file-first, bounded to 128 entries, and use environment fallback only when CFG is absent.
NewsAPI top-headlines filters are typed file-first settings with environment fallback.
NewsAPI, Yahoo News, and RSS provider base URLs require bounded HTTPS URLs with non-empty authorities and no credentials.
Market HTTP and Yahoo chart/quote provider URLs require bounded HTTPS URLs with non-empty authorities and no credentials.
Provider identity strings are non-empty and bounded to 64 bytes before registry indexing.
Canonical NewsItem URLs reject credential-bearing authorities at storage validation.
Merged CFG/environment webhook settings are validated before engine startup and delivery.
Synthetic/non-authoritative mark safety overrides are typed CFG booleans, file-first, and fail closed by default.
Non-secret IBKR account identity is typed file-first configuration while credentials remain secret inputs.
IBKR conid and instrument polling identities are typed file-first positive values captured before worker creation.
Python worker network access is a typed file-first boolean, fail-closed by default, and injected before launch.
Orders surface provides one-motion access to cancel working orders through the existing command path with explicit confirmation.
Positions surface provides one-motion opposite-quantity close drafting without bypassing order preview/risk/confirmation.
Provider/runtime strategy identifiers are escaped before compact proposal HTML rendering.
Dense order-list Cancel and Replace actions expose explicit side/instrument/quantity accessible names.
Repeated strategy proposal actions expose explicit strategy-and-symbol accessible names for Draft, TWAP, and implementation-shortfall scheduling.
Repeated proposal and order actions have explicit context-bearing accessible names enforced by contract tests.
Compact proposal-list Preview controls expose strategy-and-symbol accessible names.
Command palette command identifiers and labels are escaped before rendering, including custom workspace entries.
News feed exposes loading, provider-error-with-cache, and stale states while preserving bounded pagination and cursor continuity.
News provider failures expose an actionable retry that reuses the failed request scope, symbol, and cursor.
Initial news loads clear the prior feed before a symbol/timeframe/scope refresh; cursor pagination alone appends.
Rapid initial news context changes queue the latest request instead of silently dropping it while a prior request is in flight.
Virtualized news Pin and Details controls expose article-specific accessible names with escaped titles.
News feed exposes aria-busy during provider requests and context-specific retry labeling.
News panel surfaces bounded provider health statuses alongside the feed without exposing credentials.
Provider health chips use text labels plus status glyphs and compact glass styling, never color alone.
News view tabs expose a valid tab-to-tabpanel relationship for Relevant, All, Watchlist, and Portfolio views.
News tabs implement roving focus and Arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation.
Selected News view filter persists in a versioned presentation-only storage key and rejects invalid values.
Workspace tabs expose the controlled workspace region through an explicit aria-controls relationship.
Active workspace tab and workspace panel expose a stable labelled tabpanel relationship.
Trading right-dock tabs expose an explicit tab-to-tabpanel relationship for Positions, Orders, Watchlist, and Alerts.
Selected Trading right-dock tab persists in a versioned presentation-only key and rejects unknown values.
Workspace tab-order restore rewrites the validated fallback/order into the versioned storage key.
News stale threshold is CFG-driven, bounded to 60,000–3,600,000 ms, and generated without replacing unrelated settings.
Dense News and workspace tablists expose bounded set-size and position metadata for assistive technology.
